environment.description: Kubernetes pod running as root with default seccomp profile (RuntimeDefault). Container image based on ubuntu:22.04 with full coreutils, pg_dump, psql, and standard shell utilities available. Pod service account has no special RBAC but the container runs without any AppArmor or custom seccomp restrictions beyond the default. The Flask app is exposed via a ClusterIP service with an nginx ingress controller (no ModSecurity or WAF rules). The pod's SecurityContext has allowPrivilegeEscalation: true and capabilities include NET_RAW and SYS_PTRACE.
